messages.author: 9a2527fe18c7a82a
messages.subject: problem loading the shiny package
parts:
Hi all,

I'm an R newbie and this is my first post to the group.  I just tried loading Shiny as instructed on the webpage, but I get a 404 error (page not found).  

Suggestions?

Best,

Dan

messages.author: 7e921b60a6dff156
messages.subject: Re: problem loading the shiny package
parts:
On Sat, Nov 10, 2012 at 4:12 PM, danielbeiting <daniel...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi all,
>
> I'm an R newbie and this is my first post to the group. I just tried
> loading Shiny as instructed on the webpage, but I get a 404 error (page not
> found).

Judging by the number of people who have been able to successfully
install shiny, the code on the website is likely correct, so you're
going to have to paste in (exactly) the code that you have in your R
session and point out when the error is fired in order for you to get
any meaningful help.

You likely wrote (copy/pasted) something incorrectly, but w/o seeing
the code you used, it's impossible to tell.

HTH,
-steve

--
